t: You're on Endell Street, which runs through Covent Garden from High Holborn in the north down to Long Acre and Bow Street. It was originally called Belton Street. On the west side, look for a long, tall, narrow building, the Cross Keys, a pub built in the 1840s. The street takes its name from James Endell Tyler, who lived from 1789 to 1851. He was an Anglican clergyman and historian, a canon of St Paul's Cathedral, and Rector of St Giles in the Fields.
